import torch
from safetensors.torch import load_file

ad = torch.load("/app/model_cache/lora_adapter/adapter_model.bin", map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
print("adapter keys:", len(ad))
for k in list(ad)[:6]: print("  ", k, tuple(ad[k].shape))

merged = load_file("/app/merged_model/model.safetensors")
print("merged has lora keys:", [k for k in merged if "lora" in k])

# does the trained classifier head match?
for ak, mk in [("base_model.model.classifier.dense.weight","classifier.dense.weight"),
               ("base_model.model.classifier.dense.bias","classifier.dense.bias"),
               ("base_model.model.classifier.out_proj.weight","classifier.out_proj.weight"),
               ("base_model.model.classifier.out_proj.bias","classifier.out_proj.bias")]:
    if ak in ad and mk in merged:
        same = torch.allclose(ad[ak], merged[mk], atol=1e-6)
        print(f"{mk:34s} matches adapter: {same}  maxdiff={ (ad[ak]-merged[mk]).abs().max().item():.2e}")
    else:
        print(f"{ak} present={ak in ad} / {mk} present={mk in merged}")

# did LoRA delta get applied? compare a query weight between configured base and merged
cfg = load_file("/app/model_cache/xlm-roberta-base/model.safetensors")
for layer in ["roberta.encoder.layer.0.attention.self.query.weight",
              "roberta.encoder.layer.11.attention.self.value.weight"]:
    d = (cfg[layer] - merged[layer]).abs().max().item()
    print(f"delta applied on {layer}: maxdiff={d:.4e}  changed={d>0}")
EOF
